posts.title: Building My Own Canva Over a Weekend
posts.description: I was manually turning generated children's books into Instagram carousels, hit the limit of “doing things that don't scale,” and built a focused internal editor to make the workflow deterministic and fast.

posts.title: Building an AI agent inside a 7-year old Rails application
posts.description: We run a multi-tenant Rails application with sensitive data and layered authorization. In this post, I walk through how I added the first AI agent tool using RubyLLM, Pundit policies, and our existing Algolia search, without introducing a parallel system or loosening constraints.

posts.title: How to connect to multiple databases in Ruby on Rails 7
posts.description: A deep dive into connecting to multiple databases with Ruby on Rails exploring multiple use-cases such as read-replicas and reading from legacy sources.
